limitations: Weak-tracial-Rokhlin regularity gives simplicity, nuclearity, Z-stability and stable Morita equivalence, but UCT permanence is not established from UCT(A) alone. Rational gTR1/Elliott classification is therefore stated conditionally on UCT for the fixed-point algebra (equivalently the crossed product). Exact TR-one permanence is not claimed; for infinite compact groups the crossed product need not be unital.
provenance: Independent SCOPE audit repair on 2026-09-29. The original record incorrectly treated UCT as automatically preserved by compact/amenable crossed products and treated every compact-group crossed product as unital.
record_title: Regularity of weak-tracial-Rokhlin compact-group crossed products, with classification conditional on UCT
